findings.title: Transaction snapshot can bypass exact current tip and criterion revision
observed: REPEATABLE READ snapshot established before another canonical writer commits: same expected_latest_id=null accepted twice, both current=true, two rows.
REPEATABLE READ snapshot established before actual revision publisher commits revision2: stale revision1 inserted current=true while fresh reader reports revision2.
findings.cause: Advisory/row/table locks serialize but do not refresh a repeatable-read MVCC snapshot. Reader and writer admit all isolation levels.
findings.required: Explicitly reject isolation modes without fresh statement snapshots (in current reader and recorder), or independently prove an equivalent snapshot freshness protocol. Add retained regressions.

findings.title: Time-based authority checks use transaction start instead of current wall clock
observed: Lease expired at canonical call, but transaction opened before expiry: specialist insert current=true.
Specialist older than7 days at reviewer call, but transaction opened before cutoff: reviewer insert current=true.
findings.cause: now() remains transaction_timestamp() across lock waits and long transactions.
findings.required: Validate lease expiry and referenced specialist age against clock_timestamp() after locks, with boundary/long-transaction regressions.

verification.strict_acl_source_hold_and_locks: Retained checks pass; independent malformed corpus and read-after-writer lock coherence checks pass. These do not override the reproduced failures.
